description: Get detailed information about a specific relay

fields.name: modelKey
fields.description: The model key of the relay

fields.name: guid
fields.description: Stable identifier for the device model.

fields.name: mac
fields.description: The primary MAC address of the device.

children.name: isEnabled
children.description: Enable status LED.

children.name: id
children.description: The channel index of the relay output.

children.name: name
children.description: User-friendly name for this relay output.

children.name: type
children.description: The type of device connected to this relay output.

children.name: delay
children.description: Server-side delay in milliseconds before activation (0 = no delay, null = use default).

children.name: pulseDuration
children.description: Auto-off duration in milliseconds (0 = permanent on until manually turned off, null = use default).

children.name: state
children.description: The current state of the relay output.

children.name: rebootState
children.description: The state the relay output should be set to after a reboot/power cycle.

children.name: id
children.description: The channel index of the relay input.

children.name: name
children.description: User-friendly name for this relay input.

children.name: state
children.description: The current state of the relay input.

children.name: actionTrigger
children.description: The trigger event that activates the action.

children.name: actionType
children.description: The type of action to perform when triggered.

children.name: actionOutputId
children.description: The index of the output to control when triggered.

fields.name: wirelessConnectionState
fields.description: Wireless connection state including signal quality, battery status, and bridge connection.

children.name: signalState
children.description: Signal state.

children.name: signalQuality
children.description: Percent representation of Bluetooth signal strength.

children.name: signalStrength
children.description: dBm value of Bluetooth signal strength.

children.name: batteryStatus
children.description: Battery status.

children.name: percentage
children.description: Battery charge level from 0 to 100 (%).

children.name: isLow
children.description: Low battery charge level flag.

children.name: bridge
children.description: The ID of the bridge this device is connected through.

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/relays/{id}", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Get relay details
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/relays/{id}"
    method: GET
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
